_sources.field: Where each fact came from (URL + date). Never rendered.

gap: The one lead-capture gap found (no website, no form above the fold, Facebook-only, slow reply…). Never rendered.

company.name: Company name exactly as the prospect writes it
company.trade: Trade as a noun phrase, e.g. Roofing and gutters
company.phone: Published number, as written on their listing
company.credential: Only if published, e.g. Licensed & Insured

brand.primary: Optional hex from the prospect's own site, else omit (amber #f59e0b)

assetFolder: remodeling | carpentry | roofing | plumbing | electrical | builders (stand-in photo set)

google.profileUrl: https://www.google.com/maps/place/... (REAL numbers only, or set google to null)

hero.eyebrow: Short pill text, used only when google is null, e.g. Roofing & reliable service in Perth
hero.headline: Problem-and-outcome headline naming the trade and the city
hero.subhead: Two sentences for local homeowners. No promises of leads, revenue or guarantees.
hero.primaryCta: Optional. Default Get a quote / Get an estimate. Only say 'free' if the contractor does.
hero.secondaryCta: Optional. Default See how it works
hero.photo: Optional stand-in key for the hero: kitchen | bathroom | roofing | plumbing | electrical | framing | deck | pergola

quoteField.label: Project type | Roof need | Urgency | Service type

skyeGreeting: First chat message, in the market's tone

about.headline: You enjoy your home. We handle the <trade> work properly.
about.body: Short paragraph on what homeowners care about
about.closing: One reassuring sentence inviting them to reach out

problems.headline: Finding a reliable <trade> in <City> shouldn't be this hard.
problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a contractor just to get a clear quote.

solutions.headline: Straightforward <trade> services built around clear communication.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Quote it clearly. Build it right.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to do it properly.

finalCta.headline: Final headline
finalCta.cta: Optional, defaults to the hero CTA
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your project.

faq.q: Which areas around <City> do you cover?

faq.a: Only state a licence if it is published; else offer to send details.

faq.q: How soon can you look at my job?
What happens after I submit a request?

embeds.skyeWebhookUrl: Optional: n8n Chat Trigger URL (else env SKYE_CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL)
embeds.quickQuoteWebhookUrl: Optional: GHL inbound webhook (else env GHL_QUICK_QUOTE_WEBHOOK_URL)
